description_en: Call the ListVpcEndpointServices operation to query the endpoint services owned by your account
description_zh: 调用ListVpcEndpointServices接口，查询归属当前账号的终端节点服务列表
name: ListVpcEndpointServices

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the endpoint service is deployed.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点服务所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
A pagination token for the next query. Valid values:

Leave this parameter empty for the first query or when no further results exist.

If another query is needed, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~1000，默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint service
parameters.name: service_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the endpoint service
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the service resource
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the service resource. Valid values:

slb: The service resource is a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance.

alb: The service resource is an Application Load Balancer (ALB) instance.

nlb: The service resource is a Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance.

gwlb: The service resource is a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) instance
parameters.help_zh:
服务资源类型，取值：

slb：表示服务资源类型为传统型负载均衡CLB（Classic Load Balancer）。

alb：表示服务资源类型为应用型负载均衡ALB（Application Load Balancer）。
nlb ：表示服务资源类型为网络型负载均衡NLB（Network Load Balancer ）。
gwlb : 表示服务资源类型为网关型负载均衡 GWLB（Gateway Load Balancer）
parameters.name: service_resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically accept endpoint connections. Valid values:

true: Automatically accept endpoint connections.

false: Do not automatically accept endpoint connections
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动接受终端节点连接，取值：

true：自动接受终端节点连接。

false：不自动接受终端节点连接
parameters.name: auto_accept_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The status of the endpoint service. Valid values:

Creating: The endpoint service is being created.

Pending: The endpoint service is being modified.

Active: The endpoint service is available.

Deleting: The endpoint service is being deleted
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点服务的状态，取值：

Creating：创建中。

Pending：修改中。

Active：可用。

Deleting：删除中
parameters.name: service_status

parameters.help_en:
The business status of the endpoint service. Valid values:

Normal: The endpoint service is running as expected.

FinancialLocked: The endpoint service is locked due to an overdue payment
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点服务的业务状态，取值：

Normal：正常。

FinancialLocked：欠费锁定
parameters.name: service_business_status

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether zonal affinity is enabled for domain name resolution. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持连接服务的终端节点域名就近解析。取值：

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: zone_affinity_enabled

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the instance. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The key cannot be an empty string.

The key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
实例的标签键。最多支持20个标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the instance. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The value can be an empty string.

The value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
实例的标签值。最多支持20个标签值。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP address version. Valid values:

IPv4: IPv4 type.

DualStack: Dual-stack type
parameters.help_zh:
协议版本。取值：

IPv4：IPv4类型。
DualStack：双栈类型
parameters.name: address_ip_version
